questions.prompt: What should a native Android OAuth client use instead of an embedded secret?
questions.explanation: PKCE binds the authorization response without pretending the installed client can hide a secret.

questions.prompt: An ID token should automatically be used as an API bearer token.
questions.explanation: ID tokens describe authentication to a client, while access tokens target resource authorization.

questions.prompt: What should twenty concurrent 401s for one token generation trigger?
questions.explanation: Single-flight prevents refresh storms and rotating-token races.

questions.prompt: Every HTTP 401 should be retried forever after refreshing.
questions.explanation: Refresh and replay are bounded and only appropriate for a stale refreshable credential.

questions.prompt: How should an opaque next cursor be handled?
questions.answer: Returned unchanged to the next request
questions.explanation: Only the server defines cursor continuation meaning.
options: Returned unchanged to the next request
Decoded as a timestamp without contract

questions.prompt: Append failure should always replace existing content with a blank full-screen error.
questions.explanation: Existing items remain useful while an append-specific retry is shown.

questions.prompt: How should a large content URI be uploaded?
questions.explanation: Streaming keeps memory bounded and works with provider-backed content.
options: By loading all bytes into memory

questions.prompt: A retried upload is safe even if every attempt creates a new server ID.
questions.explanation: A lost response can create duplicates without stable idempotent identity.
